headline: Record earnings drive a raised full-year outlook
summary_short: Assurant's Q1 2026 GAAP net income rose 87% y/y to $274.1M ($5.41 diluted EPS, +91%) as catastrophes fell to $24.4M from $157.0M, and the company raised its FY2026 outlook for Adjusted EBITDA and EPS ex-catastrophes to low-single-digit growth.
summary_long: Global Lifestyle led the quarter, with ex-catastrophe Adjusted EBITDA up 19% on Connected Living subscriber growth and trade-in volumes; Global Housing's ex-cat Adjusted EBITDA fell 3% on lower favorable prior-year reserve development, though underlying results were flat. GAAP net income rose 87% y/y to $274.1M as catastrophes fell to $24.4M from $157.0M. Assurant repurchased $125M of stock, paid $44M in dividends, and held $836M of holding-company liquidity, well above its $225M minimum. Stockholders' equity was roughly flat q/q at $5,869M. Management raised FY2026 guidance: Adjusted EBITDA and EPS, both ex-catastrophes, now expected to grow low single digits (high single digits underlying), driven by ~10% Global Lifestyle EBITDA growth.
